admission.justification: The public CLI tests prevent directory formatting from rewriting JSON under unrelated hidden directories even when an operand contains children called knowledge or onboarding.

conditions: Converted memory is recognized from the existing layout marker.
The resolved directory must lie in the recognized root’s knowledge/ or onboarding/ subtree for dot-directory traversal.
exclusions: The directory walk keeps its ordinary pruning elsewhere, including unconverted roots.
Generated route-index caches remain outside directory selection.
statement: Formatting includes dot directories under converted memory roots and preserves the selection of ordinary JSON elsewhere.
